decisions.reason: Billing software sits furthest from the lighting and docking core, and the firm has already shown it will prune, but slack from an expanding firm lets it carry the product a while longer before judging it against aspirations.
Equipment monitoring uses the installed base and lifecycle service expertise and fits the data-driven direction, so with no shortfall reported there is little reason for problemistic search.

Resource management stays close to the established apron offer, but dropping turnaround management and apron connectivity weakens its complementary fit, so withdrawal risk is somewhat higher, though it is still kept for now.
The controller safety alert service builds on the firm's tower and surveillance strengths and serves customers' safety goals, so the firm keeps it while results remain uncertain.
